evidence_quote: Any physician rendering medical diagnosis and/or treatment to a person physically present in this state must have a license issued by the board when such diagnosis/treatment is rendered, regardless of the physician’s location
citation: CCHP Wyoming — Cross State Licensing, quoting WY Board of Medicine Rules Ch. 1, §§ 4 & 7
notes: Only consultation and emergency exemptions; no telehealth registration (IMLC member).

evidence_quote: Initially prescribing any controlled substance specified in W.S. 35-7-1016 through 35-7-1022 for any person through the Internet, the World Wide Web or a similar proprietary or common carrier electronic system absent a documented physician-patient relationship
citation: CCHP Wyoming — Online Prescribing, quoting Wyo. Stat. § 33-26-402(a)(xxxiii)
notes: Only requires a documented relationship before initial Internet CS prescribing; no added telehealth-specific CS limit. Low-confidence confirmation.
